title: Mechanistic insights into PCBP1-driven unfolding of selected i-motif DNA at G(1)/S checkpoint.
authors: Sengupta, Pallabi; Gillet, Natacha; Obi, Ikenna; Sabouri, Nasim
one_liner_zh: 该文研究PCBP1蛋白通过KH结构域协同作用解开i-motif DNA结构并调控G1/S检查点，结合分子动力学模拟揭示蛋白-DNA动态互作机制，虽非典型TF-DNA体系，但蛋白-DNA互作建模方法可迁移至TF-DNA研究。
abstract: I-motifs are non-canonical, four-stranded DNA structures in cytosine-rich genomic regions, yet their protein-mediated regulation remains underexplored. Here, we identify PCBP1 (Poly(rC)-binding protein 1) as a selective i-motif-binding protein that unfolds specific i-motifs depending on their protonation and hairpin-forming propensities. Systematic truncation reveals that individual K-homology (KH) domains of PCBP1 cannot selectively bind or unfold i-motifs, but their coordinated actions restore wild-type PCBP1 functions. Using biochemical, biophysical, and molecular dynamics studies, we demonstrate that KH1+2 domains remodel i-motifs, recruiting KH3 to facilitate unfolding and efficient DNA replication. Chromatin and cell-based investigations reveal that PCBP1-knockdown increases i-motif formation at specific genomic loci, coinciding with G(1)/S arrest and elevated gammaH2AX, indicative of genomic instability. During G(1)/S transition, PCBP1 occupancy peaks at these i-motif loci, ensuring i-motif resolution in early S phase. These findings establish PCBP1 as a critical regulator of i-motif dynamics, directly linking its unfolding activity to G(1)/S transition and genome stability.
abstract_zh: I-motifs是胞嘧啶富集基因组区域中的非经典四链DNA结构，然而其蛋白质介导的调控机制仍未充分探索。在此，我们鉴定PCBP1（Poly(rC)-binding protein 1）为一种选择性i-motif结合蛋白，其根据质子化和发夹形成倾向性展开特定i-motifs。系统性截断实验揭示，PCBP1的单个K-同源（KH）结构域无法选择性结合或展开i-motifs，但它们的协同作用恢复了野生型PCBP1的功能。通过生化、生物物理和分子动力学研究，我们证明KH1+2结构域重塑i-motifs，招募KH3以促进展开和高效DNA复制。染色质和细胞水平研究表明，PCBP1敲低增加了特定基因组位点的i-motif形成，与G(1)/S期阻滞和gammaH2AX升高一致，指示基因组不稳定性。在G(1)/S转变期间，PCBP1占据这些i-motif位点达到峰值，确保早期S期i-motif的解析。这些发现确立PCBP1为i-motif动态的关键调控因子，直接将其展开活性与G(1)/S转变和基因组稳定性联系起来。
